يحقوقف (form XII)

# يُحْقَوْقَفُ (yuḥqawqafu) /juħ.qaw.qa.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# يَحْقَوْقِفَ (yaḥqawqifa) /jaħ.qaw.qi.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْقَوْق
